questions.questionText: An array $A$ contains $n$ integers in locations $A[0], A[1], \dots A[n-1]$. It is required to shift the elements of the array cyclically to the left by $K$ places, where $1\leq K \leq n-1$. An incomplete algorithm for doing this in linear time, without using another array is given below. Complete the algorithm by filling in the blanks. Assume all variables are suitably declared. min:=n; i=0; while _____ do begin temp:=A[i]; j:=i; while ____ do begin A[j]:=____; j:=(j+K) mod n; if j<min then min:=j; end; A[(n+i-K)mod n]:=____; i:=______; end;
questions.questionHtml:
An array $A$ contains $n$ integers in locations $A[0], A[1], \dots A[n-1]$. It is required to shift the elements of the array cyclically to the left by $K$ places, where $1\leq K \leq n-1$. An incomplete algorithm for doing this in linear time, without using another array is given below. Complete the algorithm by filling in the blanks. Assume all variables are suitably declared.

min:=n;
i=0;
while _____ do
begin
    temp:=A[i];
    j:=i;
    while ____ do
    begin
        A[j]:=____;
        j:=(j+K) mod n;
       if j<min then
        min:=j;
    end;
    A[(n+i-K)mod n]:=____;
    i:=______;
end;

questions.excerpt: What function of $x$, $n$ is computed by this program?Function what(x, n:integer): integer: Var value : integer begin value := 1 if n  0 then begin if n mod 2 =1 then val...
questions.questionText: What function of $x$, $n$ is computed by this program? Function what(x, n:integer): integer: Var value : integer begin value := 1 if n > 0 then begin if n mod 2 =1 then value := value * x; value := value * what(x*x, n div 2); end; what := value; end;
questions.questionHtml:
What function of $x$, $n$ is computed by this program?

Function what(x, n:integer): integer:
Var
    value : integer
begin
    value := 1
    if n > 0 then
    begin
        if n mod 2 =1 then
            value := value * x;
        value := value * what(x*x, n div 2);
    end;
    what := value;
end;
